# EBSCO

> EBSCO is a leading provider of research databases, eBooks, discovery services, and institutional library solutions for academic and healthcare organizations worldwide.

EBSCO Information Services offers comprehensive digital research resources including peer-reviewed journals, full-text databases, and discovery platforms like EBSCOhost. The company serves institutions globally with solutions spanning academic research, healthcare information, and library technology.
